propositions: Parallel multi-session writes cause compaction sweep to mutate worktree (SNAPSHOT write, *.retired renames, .archived deletions) before git commit without rollback, leaving dirty tree on worker death.

Dirty worktree breaks git merge origin/tickets (untracked-file collisions and tracked-file deletions/modifications) and strands local ticket commits, creating P0 data-loss risk and blocking plan-review/close attestation.
Runtime markers (*/.archived, */.write.lock) are tracked in HEAD and never untracked despite gitignore patterns, causing routine marker churn to permanently show as tracked dirt.
Crash-atomic compaction fold with INTENT JOURNAL sentinel and recovery preamble ensures dirty state is never produced and failed folds are recoverable under write lock.
Store-wide scans (fsck, compact-all) must default to active tickets only and accept --include-archived flag to reach full store, scaling scan cost with active working set.
